choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Mock the old vow as foolish

mock_consequence.text:

Walk in the gift He gave you.

hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] A hidden vow grows weak in shadow.
Let the Lord be seen in you.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Honor the vow set apart for God

vineyard.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] A roar splits the vineyard air.
The Spirit rushes upon you.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Run and hide among the vines
[TODO:pt-BR] Beg the lion for mercy
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Stand in the strength He gave.

run_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The Spirit did not come for fleeing.
Turn and face the beast.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Stand and trust the Spirit's strength

beg_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Rise, Chosen One
beg_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He chose you to deliver Israel.
Do not bow to lion or fear.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Stand and trust the Spirit's strength
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You rise to your full height.

philistine_clash.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Philistines Press In
philistine_clash.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] They oppress your people daily.
The Spirit stirs again.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Make peace and bow to their gods
[TODO:pt-BR] Strike them down with God's strength
[TODO:pt-BR] Boast and challenge them alone
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] His arm wins, not your pride.

bow_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Serve the Lord Alone
bow_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Their idols are wood and stone.
Fight only in His name.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Strike them down with God's strength

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Give Him the Glory
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Boasting empties what He fills.
Fight humbly and let Him win.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Strike them down with God's strength

delilah_meet.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Delilah Whispers
delilah_meet.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "Tell me where your strength lies."
Her voice is honey and snare.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Reveal the secret of your hair
[TODO:pt-BR] Guard the vow and walk away
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You should have left for good.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Lie again and stay in her arms

lie_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Flee Temptation
lie_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Each lie pulls you closer to ruin.
Leave her chamber for good.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Guard the vow and walk away

guard_to_betrayed.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Heart Worn Down
guard_to_betrayed.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Day after day she presses you.
At last your weary heart breaks.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Tell her the secret in weariness
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] The vow falls with your words.

betrayed.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Razor at Dawn
betrayed.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You wake — your braids are gone.
The Spirit has departed from you.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Curse God for leaving you
[TODO:pt-BR] Repent quietly in the dark mill
[TODO:pt-BR] Blame Delilah for everything

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] He Still Hears
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Even chained and blind, He listens.
Turn your heart back to Him.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Repent quietly in the dark mill

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Own Your Vow
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] She tempted, but you chose to speak.
Confession is the first strength.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Repent quietly in the dark mill

temple_summon.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Brought Before Dagon
temple_summon.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] They mock you between the pillars.
Your hair has grown back unseen.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Beg the crowd for your freedom
[TODO:pt-BR] Pray once more for the Lord's strength
[TODO:pt-BR] Stay silent and accept defeat

beg_crowd_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Cry to Heaven
beg_crowd_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The crowd has no mercy in them.
Only One can answer now.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Pray once more for the Lord's strength

silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Israel still groans under Philistia.
Finish your judgeship in faith.

ending_redeemed.text:
